title: Bindery capture batch ingest request
description: One immutable batch of raw observations. It carries no session, execution, capture, producer, adapter or capture-method field: those are fixed by the capture the client lease resolves to, so a producer cannot restate and therefore cannot contradict them. It also carries no receive time, which is the broker's to assign.

producer_digest.description: The producer's own hash over the events it is sending. It cannot be a hash of the stored bytes, because those include a broker-assigned receive time the producer does not choose. Ingest idempotency is keyed on this together with the sequence range.
